protocol: General Cross-Project Research Protocol v0.7.1 FINAL + authoritative v0.7.1A Addendum

MFR-01.claim_text: Candidate method-scope claim: the NSD Structural Engine can recover and separately adjudicate scalar spectral, modal/carrier and selected system-organization structure on known-truth multichannel stochastic systems within a declared validity regime.
MFR-01.value_axis: identifiability / structural recovery, not empirical added value

MFR-02.note: Three-layer architecture is framework-derived; local-order, crowding-aware and rank-signal hypotheses were developed from prior P0 results and carry promotion debt. P0-D2 weak-observability and P0-D3 crowding maps further strengthen but do not pay that debt.

MFR-03.target: known synthetic poles, observable mode/subspace structure, participation and resolved relational geometry; production refusal behavior; claim-specific Function/Limit behavior
MFR-03.v0_7_1A_note: latent completeness, observable rank, individual carrier identity, invariant-subspace identity and model adequacy remain distinct target objects

MFR-04.representation: multichannel output-only SSI-COV local stochastic linear state-space estimator
MFR-04.validity_regime: synthetic stationary/local-piecewise systems currently; real EEG not licensed
implemented_p0: generic residual serial-structure diagnostic explicitly not SSI innovation

p0d4.finding: training reconstruction/stability, residual temporal structure and out-of-sample reconstruction/prediction fail in complementary directions; no single metric is sufficient

missing: frozen consequence of each contradictory diagnostic

MFR-05.conditional_estimator_comparator: SUBSPACE_DMD remains leading independent stochastic structural candidate at supplied rank

operational_rank_signal.candidate_rule_v1: largest method-native singular gap plus gap>=3, interior rank, stable selected poles, and >=1 stable positive-frequency complex mode

prospective_P0Q1.SSI_COV: SURVIVES_P0Q1: 35/35 oscillatory admission, 0/40 false refusal-family admissions
prospective_P0Q1.SUBSPACE_DMD: FAILS_P0Q1: 35/35 oscillatory admission, 2/5 false admissions in real-pole-only family, all other refusal families 0/5 false admissions

MFR-05.interpretation: The same simple truth-blind rank-signal gate is not qualified across both method families. Conditional recovery and operational selection remain separate claims.
missing: completed retrospective diagnosis of Subspace-DMD real-pole failure before any revised rule
method-native operational selection route if one exists
additional untouched qualification even for SSI-COV before P1
frozen P1 null family and alternative-model adjudication

MFR-07.expected_response: P0Q1 expected directions were frozen and executed; P0-D maps are exploratory response surfaces and cannot set their own expected directions; final P1 challenge set remains unfrozen

MFR-08.decision_rule: P0Q1 rank-signal rule is frozen only for its completed development challenge and may not be retuned/rescored; P0-D2/P0-D3/P0-D4 do not generate frozen rules; final P1 adjudication remains unfrozen

implemented_p0: separate pyOMA2 covariance-SSI analytical-uncertainty reference workflow

compatibility.pyOMA2: common aligned interval across Hankel blocks
compatibility.consequence: direct reuse of pyOMA2 uncertainty matrix for current NSD estimator is not authorized

missing: NSD-native sampling covariance/uncertainty derivation for the actual covariance-Hankel estimator
independent known-truth calibration of that implementation

MFR-10.known_dependence: Phase 0C and all pre-P0Q1 stress records are development/calibration evidence. P0-D1 through P0-D4 are exploratory/post-result mapping and cannot confirm rules derived from them. P0Q1 was frozen before result generation but remains P0 promotion-debt evidence, not P1.
MFR-10.future: new untouched P0-Q evidence required for any operationalized P0-D rule; real-data and Atlas pathway map required

MFR-11.note: P0-D maps preserve search surfaces without promoting selected thresholds; P1 family is not frozen because decisive design does not yet exist

MFR-13.falsifier: failure of any layer-specific frozen recovery/refusal/adjudication criterion on a future untouched P1 holdout; exact criteria pending final P1 freeze

MFR-14.failure_consequence: failed layer/version is not qualified; preserve result; no retuning on same holdout; any revision requires new version and new untouched evidence

P0D_FUNCTION_LIMIT_EVIDENCE.P0D1: balanced nominal/perturbed/boundary candidate-generation map; provenance-repair rerun preserved result
P0D_FUNCTION_LIMIT_EVIDENCE.P0D2: weak observability separates latent completeness from observable-rank recovery; post-result
P0D_FUNCTION_LIMIT_EVIDENCE.P0D3: crowding separates individual carrier identity from invariant-subspace identity; post-result
